note: The gallery's own six places, stated as a site plan: the same hall, annex, loft, undercroft and exit the primary campaign builds out of prefab pieces, embedded here as a region, a box per place and a seam per connection. It is an overlay rather than primary surface because a campaign has ONE placement authority — the primary places pieces with `areas[]`, and a site plan places the whole map in its own region, so a world carrying both would have two owners for one question. The overlay also ships its own geometry brief: its facts are the numbers this embedding is designed to, which are not the numbers written about the piece the primary assembles.
